purpose: Canonical machine-readable architecture for the agent-agnostic Penpot design workflow, from session entry to delivery.

entry.session_lifecycle: Each supported launcher creates a fresh, process-scoped pending session under ignored .local/.
entry.mandatory_question: Você quer preparar/subir a infraestrutura do Penpot (conta local e MCP incluídos) ou iniciar/continuar a implementação de designs no Penpot?

actors.responsibility: Choose route; supply sources or a prompt; answer intake, addendum, ambiguity, scope, and review questions; approve delivery.
Run controller; assign profiles; preserve gates and evidence; review worker handoffs; own final score and state decisions.
Execute delegated hands-on capture, analysis, construction, or correction using the resolved cost-efficient model.
Provide CLI host, Python, Docker/Compose, browser automation, network access, and Penpot MCP as required.

cross_cutting_components.lessons: Each skill owns project and machine lesson buckets; only project lessons are versioned.

cross_cutting_components.policy: Prefer cost-efficient delegated workers; record concrete resolved runtime/model; require image-capable worker for visual phases.

infrastructure.purpose: Prepare one shared local Penpot instance for future projects.

steps.action: Run setup.sh; prepare Python/Playwright dependencies and validate Compose configuration.
Create or preserve root .env without overwriting existing deployment configuration; keep file private.
Start Penpot Compose services and wait for readiness.
Log in to or create the local automation account.
Reuse or create the MCP access token, enable MCP, and store endpoint/token in root .env.
Return automation account email/password to the user; never print the MCP token; mark session INFRA_READY.

design.purpose: Create or reconstruct static, editable Penpot screens, then formalize and deliver the approved design system.

required_actions: Ask scope questions
Ask a final addendum/change question
Analyze remaining ambiguities and ask further questions when needed
Capture the full finite page
Check whether desktop, mobile, or both layouts exist
Map provenance and state
Inventory exact source assets before seeking substitutes
Measure viewport, document, overflow, and frame bounds

desktop_policy.finite_page: Capture and design full page height
desktop_policy.horizontal_growth: Only when intentional page-level horizontal behavior is evidenced

required_actions: Refine prompt-only intent with the user
Record the approved brief and bounded screen states
Present decisions and plan
Wait for user approval before building
Resolve profile and actual runtime/model
Record runtime/model in handoff
Require image-capable worker for visual phases
Parallelize read-only source preparation only when safe

forbidden: concurrent mutations, inventory, or exports against the same active Penpot file

required_actions: Create editable Penpot frames using MCP
Prefer exact source assets
Build components/structure rather than embedding a reference screenshot as the design
Record append-only MCP operations
Export every target viewport/frame
Score each screen against source or approved brief
Generate localized issues and visual comparisons
Have orchestrator/reviewer inspect score and evidence

phases.entry_condition: Automated validation failed and cycle number is less than 3.
required_actions: Refactor only regions and causes named in issues
Do not modify evaluator-owned score, thresholds, source evidence, or prior immutable cycle artifacts

phases.entry_condition: Automated and structural gates pass, or an explicit review-needed state is being presented.

branches.action: Record feedback and refine/rebuild the next version using the last version as input; revalidate the new version.

phases.entry_condition: Explicit user approval of the prototype.
required_actions: Create reusable tokens, styles, components, variants, and instances
Re-inventory structure
Re-export and revalidate after formalization
Require post-design-system structural and visual gates
Package sanitized traceability, comparison evidence, and report
Leave private source captures, credentials, and raw Penpot exports out of Git unless explicitly allow-listed

specialist_profiles.mission: Capture page states, page extent, viewports, and source provenance.
Inspect DOM/CSS/code, breakpoints, geometry, layout behavior, and overflow.
Define hierarchy, screen structure, and desktop/mobile matrix.
Specify visual language, content, typography, density, and assets.
Create editable Penpot frames and reusable components through MCP.
Inspect visual diffs, asset provenance, content, accessibility, and editability.
Formalize design tokens, styles, components, and variants after approval.

invariants: Ask and record infrastructure-or-design choice before route operations.
Ask intake questions and the final addendum question before building.
Map every supplied source and inventory original useful assets before building.
Use whole-page finite source extent; 1440x900 is a desktop observation viewport and minimum frame, not a full-page height cap.
A visual worker must open an image and record image hash plus concrete observation; this is an auditable attestation, not proof of subjective comprehension.
Use cost-efficient delegated hands-on workers where supported; orchestrator remains the final reviewer and score owner.
Allow at most three automated correction cycles per version; third failed cycle stops at NEEDS_REVIEW.
Do not formalize the design system until user approval; revalidate after formalization.
Keep machine-local credentials/session state out of Git.
Repository guards constrain supported repository commands, not an agent that deliberately bypasses the repo and directly invokes an external MCP server.
